text: 23 This is my house. I live here with my family. Our house has two bedrooms, a kitchen and a living room. We cook food in the kitchen. There is a small garden in front of our house. My house is a beautiful place to live in. We watch T.V. in the living room. 1. Listen, repeat and read. My House 2.4 3. Listen, read and write. 2.
